name: Sonic Wave
doc: Sonic Wave (Oilboyle's enemy attack): the master and the main task - the wave from the caster's bone point to the targets: its layout, the screen warps, one target task a target tinting it, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag139_sonic_wave.cpp) run on the program's memory (its module copy of the data block; its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The sonic wave from the caster's bone point to the targets: its layout, the screen warps, the target tasks tinting the targets, the sound; the damage

params.label: Target
params.doc: The prim-model layout target (its models' animation)

params.label: Main
params.doc: The prim-model layout main (its models' animation)

params.label: Model 11D4E90
params.doc: The prim model at 0x11D4E90 (a mesh of 201 vertices, 380 primitives: its code copies it whole into a block of its size: an edited one keeps its vertices and its size (move vertices, change colours and texture corners))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Colours
params.doc: The colours it blends through: three, then the two its last steps read past them (its texture name's first bytes) (20 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

not_editable.label: Frames
not_editable.doc: 4 wave frames of 0x650 bytes (same layout, no triangles)
